articles.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI
articles.excerpt: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.

image.alt: Diagram of an agentic task as a loop: search, read results, refine, verify, and decide, with each step a separate billed call to the frontier model

articles.title: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock
